name: Administrative Building (Prashasnik Bhawan)
description: Main nerve centre of the university housing Vice Chancellor Secretariat, Registrar Office, Finance & Accounts Branch, Scholarship Section, and Proctor Office.
landmark: Near Main University Flagpost & Patharia Hills Campus Entry

name: Examination Building (Pariksha Bhawan)
description: Houses Controller of Examinations (CoE), examination confidential sections, marksheet issuance counters, and grievance desk for exam queries.
landmark: Adjacent to the Main Administrative Block

name: Jawaharlal Nehru Central Library
description: Multi-storey modern university library housing over 400,000 volumes, reading halls, e-resource laboratory, periodicals, and research carrels.
landmark: Centrally situated between Faculty of Arts and Science Complex

name: Computer Science & Applications (CSA) Building
description: Houses Department of Computer Science & Applications (MCA, M.Sc., Ph.D.), modern computing labs, software engineering center, and server rooms in the Valley Campus.
landmark: Valley Campus (Gour Nagar), Dr. Harisingh Gour Vishwavidyalaya

name: Dean Students' Welfare (DSW) Complex
description: Hub for cultural activities, student union & welfare counseling, scholarship facilitation, youth festival preparations, and student clubs.
landmark: Opposite Student Activity Centre / University Auditorium

name: University Health Centre
description: On-campus health facility providing OPD consultations, emergency medical care, dressing, free generic medicines, and ambulance transport.

name: Rabindranath Tagore Boys' Hostel & Chief Warden Office
description: Prominent boys' hostel and headquarters of the Chief Warden Office for university hostel administration.

name: University Sports Complex & Gymnasium
description: Facilities for athletics, football, cricket, basketball, badminton, table tennis, and a modern gymnasium for students and athletes.
